acceptanceCriteria.text: A canonical Runtime Appliance built from one exact current `main` commit is published to GHCR using the existing Runtime Appliance OCI contract.
The immutable OCI manifest digest is recorded and resolves successfully from GHCR.
The published manifest/layers match the existing artifact/media-type contract; no alternative package format is introduced.
Published metadata identifies the exact source revision and canonical raw Appliance identity.
The compressed/raw identities required by the existing consumer contract are present and internally consistent.
A complete `runtime-spec.json` is produced with the exact `registry`, `repository`, and immutable `digest`.
`mottainai-init` can consume that spec without requiring a mutable tag, local source checkout, or publication-only override.
The final Issue/PR evidence includes the exact deployment commands for a Linux x86_64 host with usable `/dev/kvm`.
No unrelated Runtime, Lima, Manager, migration, compatibility, or CLI redesign is included.

issue.title: release(runtime): publish the canonical Runtime Appliance to GHCR for immediate dogfood deployment
